mukta-m0-p22-v526.quick_english: Tārā indeed is a great knowledge, and likewise Tripurasundarī.

mukta-m0-p22-v527.quick_english: Tvaritā and Annapūrṇā, and likewise Vāgvādinī, O beloved.

mukta-m0-p22-v528.quick_english: Dhūmāvatī and Bhairavī, and likewise Pratyaṅgirā and others.

mukta-m0-p22-v529.quick_english: By reciting the mantras of these goddesses, sleep is broken.

mukta-m0-p22-v530.quick_english: What harm could there be in their recitation and worship? It becomes higher and higher.

mukta-m0-p22-v531.quick_english: In the four ages beginning with Satya, and among all classes, there is Kālikā.

mukta-m0-p22-v532.quick_english: There I shall tell the means by which success arises.

mukta-m0-p22-v533.quick_english: Then success arises after a long time; there is no doubt about this.

mukta-m0-p22-v534.quick_english: Recitation and worship of these goddesses is always commended, O one praised by heroes.

mukta-m0-p22-v535.quick_english: O fortunate one, O mother, devotion to the guru arises, if it may be.

interrogative particle introducing a rhetorical question

mukta-m0-p22-v526.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v526.question: Which goddesses are identified as great knowledges alongside Tārā?
premises: Tārā is named explicitly.
Tārā is identified as a great knowledge.
Tripurasundarī is likewise included.
mukta-m0-p22-v526.inference: Tārā and Tripurasundarī are both counted among the great knowledges.

mukta-m0-p22-v527.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v527.question: Which additional goddesses are enumerated in address to the beloved?
premises: Tvaritā is named in the list.
Annapūrṇā is added by conjunction.
Vāgvādinī is likewise included.
mukta-m0-p22-v527.inference: Tvaritā, Annapūrṇā, and Vāgvādinī are included among the enumerated goddesses.

mukta-m0-p22-v528.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v528.question: Which further goddesses complete the enumerated group including Pratyaṅgirā?
premises: Dhūmāvatī is named in the list.
Bhairavī is added by conjunction.
Pratyaṅgirā and others are likewise included.
mukta-m0-p22-v528.inference: Dhūmāvatī, Bhairavī, and Pratyaṅgirā with others complete this enumeration.

mukta-m0-p22-v529.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v529.question: What effect arises from reciting the mantras of these goddesses?
premises: The referent is the previously named goddesses.
Their recitation mantra is employed.
Breaking of sleep arises from this practice.
mukta-m0-p22-v529.inference: Recitation of these goddesses' mantras causes the breaking of sleep.

mukta-m0-p22-v530.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v530.question: Does continued recitation and worship of these goddesses cause any harm?
premises: The practice concerns recitation and worship of these goddesses.
The question asks about possible harm.
The practice is considered progressively higher and higher.
mukta-m0-p22-v530.inference: There is no harm in their recitation and worship; it becomes progressively superior.

mukta-m0-p22-v531.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v531.question: For whom and in which ages is Kālikā accessible as a deity?
premises: The context spans the four ages beginning with Satya.
The context includes all classes.
Kālikā is affirmed in this universal scope.
mukta-m0-p22-v531.inference: Kālikā is accessible in all four ages and among all classes.

mukta-m0-p22-v532.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v532.question: What promise is made regarding the means to attain success with Kālikā?
premises: The speaker intends to tell the means.
The means pertain to that context.
Success arises through those means.
mukta-m0-p22-v532.inference: The speaker will explain the means by which success in that context arises.

mukta-m0-p22-v533.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v533.question: How certain and timely is the attainment of success through these means?
premises: Success arises after a long time.
The arising of success is affirmed.
Doubt about this matter is explicitly denied.
mukta-m0-p22-v533.inference: Success will certainly arise, though only after a long time.
uncertainties: Surface 'saṃśyaḥ' may reflect a variant spelling of 'saṃśayaḥ'.

mukta-m0-p22-v534.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v534.question: What ongoing practice toward these goddesses is commended to the praised one?
premises: Recitation and worship of these goddesses is the subject.
This practice is to be done always.
The practice is explicitly commended.
mukta-m0-p22-v534.inference: Constant recitation and worship of these goddesses is commended.

mukta-m0-p22-v535.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p22-v535.question: Under what condition does devotion to the guru arise in the practitioner?
premises: Devotion to the guru is the outcome in question.
The arising of this devotion is conditional.
The condition is introduced by 'if'.
mukta-m0-p22-v535.inference: Devotion to the guru arises if the requisite condition is fulfilled.
uncertainties: The protasis condition is not explicitly stated in this verse alone.
